node.statement: Proof by contradiction with explicit fiber notation. Fix arbitrary finite I, A, tau, t, a and a putative matrix P satisfying every hypothesis of node 1. For each full row-point fiber Q (an equivalence class for i~j iff p_i=p_j), let p_Q be its common row and define c_Q:=sum_{j in Q} P_{vj}, d_Q:=sum_{j in Q}(P_{zj}-P_{vj}), and e_Q:=sum_{j in Q}(P_{oj}-P_{vj}); thus the contract's top-row mass is c_Q. Call Q a support fiber exactly when (c_Q,d_Q,e_Q)!=(0,0,0), and call the five fibers of v,w,f,z,o actors. Put P_i(S):=sum_{j in S}P_{ij}, x_j:=x_[j], y_j:=y_[j], H:=conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o}, and Ext:={Q: Q is a support fiber and p_Q is not in H}. The child calculations derive the exact identity sum_Q x_Q d_Q=1 but an absolute upper bound strictly below 1 for the same sum. This contradiction discharges the arbitrary supposition and proves node 1.
